items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 34:1
items.html: From the second restriction onward, which was established in Atzilut — meaning that Malchut, who is the bottom Hey, was included and joined in the first Hey, in the secret of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment — the Malchut of AK, who is from the discernment of the first restriction, is considered a concealed Malchut. And although she clothes in the Rosh of Atik of Atzilut, still her illumination is not revealed at all in Atzilut, as the ARI writes above (p. 618, Item 24), that in the future she is revealed from that Rosh that is not known, in the secret of the verse, “the stone the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone.” (p. 618, Item 23)
